subject: Intro & Demo cadence — VP/CTO alignment and next-step slots
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Romero <dani.romero@finex.co>, Alex Brooks <alex.brooks@finex.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro & Demo cadence — VP/CTO alignment and next-step slots

Hi Danielle (and Alex),

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great overview of Finex’s fraud-detection throughput and the latency targets you mentioned. To keep momentum we’d like to: 1) introduce Alex (CTO) to our VP-level exec to align on success criteria and procurement path, and 2) schedule a technical deep dive/demo focused on your streaming inference use case.

Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce 95th-pct inference latency to <75ms for the realtime scoring path.
- Volume profile: peak 300 qps, average 40 qps, many short sequences (<=128 tokens).
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option, predictable egress billing.

Proposed next steps (please pick options that work for your team):
A) VP/CTO intro (30 min) — internal exec alignment and procurement ramp
   - Tue Jun 22 10:00–10:30 PT
   - Tue Jun 22 15:00–15:30 PT
B) Technical deep dive / demo (60 min) — runtime behavior, KV caching, autoscale profiles
   - Wed Jun 23 09:30–10:30 PT
   - Wed Jun 23 13:00–14:00 PT

Attached a short mutual action plan and our SOC2 summary so your security and procurement teams have what they need. If those slots don’t work, share a couple alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0148

I’ll loop in procurement after the VP/CTO sync. Please confirm and send a calendar invite.

Cheers,

Great — calendar invite going out now for Tue Jun 22 15:00–15:40 PT (25-min intro + 15-min procurement buffer). Agenda in invite: intros, top-level success metrics, procurement timeline, immediate blockers.

For the Wed deep dive, we’ll present a focused 45-min demo + 15-min Q&A covering:
- runtime latency tradeoffs (KV cache, batching),
- recommended quantization for Finex workloads,
- autoscaling and cost predictability for reserved pools.

Also attaching a short pre-demo checklist so Miguel can drop any extra items before Wed.

Marissa Cole
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference
